Requested before merge:

1. Class: wrong playback of fixed steel. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs:218` turns every visible model. This includes a fixture whose `FixtureDef.fixed` is true. The gate leaves that fixture fixed (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs:192-205`). For an A-line at the origin and a -Y pose, a fixed point at `[0, 5, 0]` moves to `[0, 0, -5]`. The playback can therefore show a different clearance from the gate. Apply a work-side membership rule before each scene transform. Keep fixed steel in the machine frame. Add a scene test with one turning fixture and one fixed fixture.

2. Class: inconsistent display frames. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs:344` moves the tool body to the carried tip. The tool marker still uses the original `f.pos` and `f.axis` (`shell.rs:395-396`). The path overlay also keeps the original coordinates (`world.rs:412`; `interact.rs:998`). The shadow uses the original `ModelSrc` (`world.rs:219`). At the pose in finding 1, the tool tip is `[0, 0, -5]`, while its marker remains at `[0, 5, 0]`. Use one display transform for each work-side scene element and the corresponding tool marker. Keep machine-side elements fixed. Test the marker, path, model and shadow together at a nonzero rotary pose.

3. Class: frame-cache law. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs:383-385` transforms every vertex on every collection. A paused playhead repeats the same work for the models, stock and fills. This breaks upstream `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, "Frame cost": a still frame computes no derived geometry again. Cache transformed geometry by its actual inputs, or apply the transform in the draw stage. Add the required counter test for a still frame and a test for changed inputs. Do not use `doc_version` alone as the cache key.

4. Class: crate-placement law. `crates/app/src/sim_machine_view.rs:30` imports only `WorkTurn`. The new module operates only on vectors, angles and vertices. It reads none of the five document concerns. This breaks upstream AGENTS.md, "app holds the document, nothing else". Move this math and its unit tests to `camcraft-sim`. Re-export the API from `app` for the UI.

The seven new math tests passed. The PR adds no scene test for the fixed-fixture, marker, shadow or still-frame cases above.

This is a re-review of the new head `55d4b8677`. Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4277#issuecomment-7210326379.

## Earlier findings (mkinney review on `8751fc52a`)

1. Fixed steel turns with the work - **fixed.** `work_turn::turns_with_work` (`crates/ui/src/work_turn.rs:76-79`) uses the same split as the gate (`fixture::workholding_for`, `crates/app/src/fixture.rs:194-207`). A fixture with `fixed == true` gets no transform. `world.rs` applies the rule for each model before the turn. Pinned by `sim_work_turn::the_scene_turns_the_turning_fixture_and_keeps_the_fixed_one` and `work_turn::tests::the_membership_rule_follows_the_gate`. Both pass.
2. Inconsistent display frames - **fixed.** The marker reads `shell::sim_marker_pose`, which calls the same `posed_tool` as the tool body. The path lines turn through `path_overlay::turned` with the same `play_view`. The shadow is built from the turned `ModelSrc.verts`, and its cache key now includes the turn bits (`shade_cache.rs`). Pinned by `sim_work_turn::one_display_frame_shares_the_turn_between_marker_path_model_and_shadow`: marker at `[0, 0, -5]`, tool z-min -5, model turned, shadow y-max below 40, path equal to the unturned lines under the same turn. Passes.
3. Frame-cache law - **fixed.** `frame_cache::TurnedCache` keys on the source allocation, its length, a probe of the first and last element, and the turn bits. No document counter is in the key. Fills key on a fresh `frame_memo` fill id for each kept answer. Pinned by `sim_work_turn::a_paused_playhead_turns_no_geometry_again_and_a_scrub_does`, `frame_cache::tests::a_still_frame_turns_no_geometry_again_and_a_changed_turn_does` and `a_changed_source_builds_again_even_at_the_same_turn`. All pass.
4. Crate placement - **fixed.** The math is now in `crates/sim/src/machine_view.rs` with its unit tests. `crates/app/src/lib.rs` re-exports it (`pub use camcraft_sim::machine_view as sim_machine_view`). `camcraft-app` already depends on `camcraft-sim`, so the PR adds no new crate edge.

## NeoTech's review on this head (posted 05:07Z, commit `55d4b8677`)

NeoTech's review lists five items. Items 2-5 are the four findings above, and they are fixed. Item 1 is not done:

- NeoTech item 1, missing sim-level pinning test - **not fixed.** The body says "`Frame` carries `work` through `Script::at` (all 5 windows), default `None`". The code is correct: each arm of `Script::at` (`crates/sim/src/sim.rs:299-384`) sets `work` from the right segment, and the empty script gives `None`. But no test in `camcraft-sim` reads `Frame::work`. A search of `crates/sim` finds no assert on `.work` of a `Frame`. The UI tests reach only the mid-move window (`t = 0.5`). Add one sim test, as NeoTech asked: build a small script with two segments that carry different `WorkTurn` values (one with a dwell), and assert `Script::at(..).work` for the empty script, `t <= 0`, `t >= total`, a non-finite `t`, the mid-move window, the dwell window and the past-window arm.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs` has 374 lines on main, 414 at the earlier head and 536 now. The five `turned_*` / `view_bits` helpers (`world.rs:392-511`) caused most of the growth. NeoTech calls the 400-line rule a flag for this file. Moving the helpers into `crates/ui/src/work_turn.rs` (95 lines) is a mechanical split that brings `world.rs` back to about 410 lines.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/sim_work_turn.rs:74` and `crates/ui/src/work_turn_tests.rs:68` contain a mis-encoded degree sign (`-90ÃƒÆ’...°`). Write `-90 degrees` or a correct `°`.
- `TurnedCache` keys on a raw allocation address and does not hold the source alive (`world_verts_cached` uses a `Weak`). A freed and re-used allocation with the same length and the same first and last element can show a stale turned stock mesh for one frame. The probes make this unlikely, and it is display only. A `Weak` key would close it.
- The PR body still says "The math lives in the new `camcraft_app::sim_machine_view`". It now lives in `camcraft_sim::machine_view` and `app` re-exports it.
- `shell.rs` (1216 lines) and `sim.rs` (1243 lines) were already over 400 lines. They grow by 51 and 29 lines.
